extraction.name: MVBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive multi-modal video understanding benchmark covering 20 challenging video tasks that require temporal understanding and cannot be effectively solved with a single frame.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The data collection process involves filtering videos from 11 existing public video benchmarks based on diversity, temporal sensitivity, and question difficulty, and then automatically generating multiple-choice QAs using LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: 11 public video datasets covering a broad spectrum of domains and scenes, ranging from first-person to third-person perspectives, and from indoor to outdoor environments.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Automatic annotation paradigm that converts existing public video annotations into multiple-choice QAs using LLMs. Questions are generated based on task definitions, and answer options are created via template-based construction or LLM-based generation.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Automatic conversion of existing video annotations into multiple-choice question-answer pairs.
